synopsis: March 2022 RTCA SC-147 minutes recorded European encounter-model results suggesting ACAS Xa induced more near mid-air collisions than TCAS, while MIT Lincoln Laboratory did not see the same disparity [f1436, f15754]. The booklet frames this divergence as a disagreement over encounter or scenario model representativeness, rather than a settled comparative safety conclusion [f1968]. Sensor noise had not been assessed in the comparison, leaving an explicit evaluation gap [f1437, f1968]. For validation planning, the booklet treats the disagreement as a warning against relying on a single simulation toolchain [f1969].
